ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% low-intensity (black) to 25% high-intensity (white) distribution; white pixels are predominantly localized at the lateral tips and distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobes exhibit solid low-intensity pigmentation. High-contrast white mottling is concentrated at the lateral extremities (tips). A unique, high-intensity circular ring feature is visible in the upper-medial quadrant of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, well-defined V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 50-60 degrees at the convergence of the lobe midlines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations present along the entirety of the trailing edge boundary; peak-to-valley amplitude is most pronounced on the mid-to-outer sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges follow a concave trajectory toward the tips, while the leading edges exhibit irregular convex protrusions associated with barnacle colonization.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of roughly circular, high-intensity pixel groups (barnacles) are prominent along the extreme outer tips and leading edges of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological encrustation (barnacles) creating significant topographical irregularity along the distal margins; possible minor tissue loss at the extreme right tip.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly distinctive 'O-shaped' high-contrast white ring located on the upper-mid section of the left lobe pigmentation.
